Senses.Explanation: To carry the cangue and submit one’s own indictment is to incriminate oneself by the very answer or claim offered in defense. Chan speakers use the legal image when someone’s words supply both the restraint and the charge against him. Muzhou Daoming applies it after a questioner claims that Muzhou knows; another Muzhou record uses it when a questioner asks where his speech went wrong. Cuiyan Kezhen gives it as the answer defining a person of the Way. The official Zheng Gongbu turns it back on Fenyang during their exchange.
